title: Night market editorial direction
design_system: Project-specific expressive editorial; Material expressiveness as contrast
brief: Propose two meaningfully different visual directions for an independent night-market magazine. Provide text specifications and a small original SVG concept for each; no application build.
context: Brand direction is energetic and handmade: acid yellow #F4FF3A, black, large type, asymmetry and visible texture are welcome. Main task: discover this week’s feature, then find practical visiting information. Content: Lantern Makers After Dark; Friday 18:00–23:00; East Wharf; free entry. Both directions must preserve this information.

user_facts.preferred_style: Expressive editorial, not a software dashboard
user_facts.motion: Optional; avoid making essential information depend on it

constraints: Use original vector shapes and text, no copied photography or logos.
The two directions must differ in composition, not only colors.
Treat large type and asymmetry as permitted choices.

checks.criterion: Both proposals use the requested expressive character and do not replace it with an unrelated restrained SaaS visual language.
The proposals differ in composition and reading sequence, with an explanation of the tradeoff.
Each SVG contains feature title, Friday hours, East Wharf and free entry as readable text.
Does not reject asymmetry or large type merely because those features depart from Compass defaults.
